The report says the app crashes on startup after an upgrade, but contains no stack trace, logs, or version details, so it cannot yet be handed to engineering for a fix.

3. Platform/OS version and device (iOS/Android/desktop).
4. Steps to reproduce: does it crash on cold start only, or also after the system kills and relaunches it?
